title: Research Grok Bot conversation storage
description:
Research where the Grok Bot desktop AI assistant app stores conversations on macOS: app container paths, database or file formats, session and authorship semantics, timestamps, and any dedup or fork behavior. Cite public docs or source where they exist; mark anything unverifiable as an assumption to check against a real Mac with the app installed. Nothing is assumed from the other adapters — Grok Bot gets its own research pass.

Done when: a research summary with citations or clearly marked assumptions is recorded on this issue and validated against a real Mac.
